delta_vs_v22.locator_access: +68 Ir/record (4 probes x 6 levels x 10 Ir)
delta_vs_v22.yield: q re-measured on the key predicate: 1.0 (2534/2534 nontrivial)

collision_finding.mechanism: after the 16-pass radix sort on the 256-bit key, equal keys are adjacent in the sorted stream; the find pass is one 32-byte adjacency comparison per record. No hash-bucket scan is used or charged: the bucket in key_equal_v23.py is a measurement device for the same key-equality predicate.

locator.mechanism: one 122-bit page resolution per record: 6-level radix walk (fanout 2^21) carrying a 128-bit anchor in two GPR words, with add/adc carry, digit shift/mask, node slot address and tag test
locator.note: one 128-bit page resolution (60 Ir) + one 32-byte adjacency key compare (8 Ir) = 68 Ir/record, charged IN ADDITION to the v22 sort price; no hash-bucket scan is charged

policy.record_fields: 32B canonical key || 20B identity pack (20-bit trail || 108-bit step)
policy.rule: every hit replays both trails from their stored identities; the replay reconstructs the exact point (resolving the sign class) and recovers x from the matching linear relation

returns.basis: MEASURED cycle-entry rate at the fixture cells: 13/8000, 25/4000, 6/4000, CP-95 upper bound on the worst cell charged as the per-trail relative work loss (0.009212 -> log2 0.013230). No state-space cardinality expression is used.
returns.conjecture: the fixture's state space is 2^22.3; production is q*R = 2^276, so the charged rate is a conservative measured upper bound, not a derived production probability
returns.unit: trail (a trail whose (point, phase) state repeats is truncated and its remaining records are lost)

peaks.layout: 85 records per 4096 B page, two streams, 16 B locator entries

poisson_fit.note: two tests are reported: the model-mean chi-square tests the claimed lambda (and misfits if the measured rate is low); the fitted-mean chi-square tests Poisson SHAPE only and is not used as confirmation of the claimed rate

success.charged_basis: minimum CP-95 lower bound over the three seeded key-collision cells (1788/4000, 1757/4000, 1797/4000), i.e. a lower bound measured on the actual predicate, not a cardinality count
success.moments_note: E[X(X-1)]/E[X]^2 measured 1.3356 / 1.3800 / 1.3083 vs 1.0 for Poisson (mild clustering: the model-mean chi-square is 25.41 / 34.19 / 16.58 on 3 dof, reported honestly and NOT used to confirm the rate); Paley-Zygmund at production moments is 0.387584 and is reported as the distribution-free floor, below the measured CP lower bound that is charged
success.predicate: KEY EQUALITY: bucket = key & (R-1); probe reaches entry; canonical x compares equal; the replay resolves T=T' vs T=-T' and recovers x by the matching linear relation
success.residual_conjecture: r = 32759 measured here vs r = 2^255 at production. The measured law is the uniform-key-within-bucket law (key hazard 1/r, bucket hazard 1/R, conditional R/r). Extrapolating it to 2^255 sign classes over 2^107.67-step trails is the class-scale equidistribution conjecture, disclosed and not claimed.
success.yield_basis: 2534/2534 nontrivial key-equal events recovered; 1228 same-point, 1306 opposite-point, 0 trivial duplicates
